proposal.thesis: LPL Financial is the independent-advisor custodian whose economics are cash-sweep fees plus advisory AUM, not AI-server units. Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30; 8-K 2026-07-30) printed revenue $5.187B (+35% YoY), net income $379.3M, and client-cash revenue $443.5M (+12% YoY) on $54.1B of bank sweep at a 337bp net yield; ICA fees are based on prevailing rates and DCA per-account fees rise with the fed-funds target (10-Q filed 2026-08-03). The 15-analyst mean is $430 (+24.6% vs Friday's $353.78 close; news_and_catalysts) and the conservative 17-analyst 3-month mean is $405.79 (+16.8% vs the $347.58 live mark at 11:57 a.m. ET 2026-09-14, PriceTargets.com). Stage-2 still holds (above the 50- and 200-DMA, trend_up_50_over_200, 3m RS +20.2%); the chart is a pullback onto the rising 50-day after the $380 area, RSI 49.2. Live options spot $345.10 is under the written $352 fill. Demand_driver is financials on a 100% cash book, beta 0.39, while HPE/DELL/LITE are dumping on the Amodei/Altman slowdown tape. Sized at ~70% of the risk-based seat so a later add can sit above cost.
catalysts: Wednesday 2026-09-16 FOMC: a hike that is already ~90% priced leaves ICA/DCA sweep yields intact rather than cutting them
Q3 FY2026 print due 2026-10-29: client-cash revenue and bank-sweep yield versus Q2's $443.5M / 337bps
proposal.macro_context: SPY 764.29 sits above its 50-DMA (758.62) and 200-DMA (712.06), so the regime gate is supportive, but momentum_health is softening (SPMO -6.9% off its 20d high vs SPY -1.4%) and Monday 2026-09-14 is an AI-hardware selloff into a 5% 10-year and a likely Wednesday hike. That is the Moreira-Muir size-path tape: take a non-momentum-continuation diversifier, not another hyperscaler_server_capex seat. LPLA is that seat.
proposal.risk_map: Institutions_selling_price_weak, CMF20 -0.128, DI- 25.9 vs DI+ 13.1, and Group MD Gates's $1.46M non-plan sale on 2026-08-20 are a distribution tape — this is a 50-day test, not a confirmed hold. TTM FCF is -$931M (deteriorating, Q ended 2026-06-30); that is a broker working-capital swing, not a SaaS kill, but a print that shows client cash leaving the platform would be. A Wednesday hike that gaps financials through $334 is the geometric risk; the 4.57% stop sits above the 3.98% noise floor (max of 1x ATR 2.94% and 0.5x the 7.95% 32-day expected move) but inside a full expected-move band, which is why size is a starter. Prior LPLA tickets died on tests_red:test_partial_broker_side_fill_leaves_a_correct_remainder; this pack carries no tests_gate/risk_halts flag, so the block is treated as cleared plumbing, not a thesis veto.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 15 analysts rate it a buy (mean 1.82) with a $430 target, and the conservative 17-analyst 3-month mean is $405.79; the tape is pricing a 5% 10-year and a Wednesday hike as multiple compression for financials, which is why the stock is testing the 50-day at live ~$345 with institutions_selling_price_weak. MY VIEW: LPL is not a duration-sensitive bank book — it is an independent-RIA custodian whose largest rate-sensitive line is client-cash sweep, which pays LPL more when policy rates stay high. MECHANISM: the 10-Q (filed 2026-08-03) states ICA fees are based primarily on prevailing interest rates and DCA fees increase as the federal-funds target rises, subject to a cap; Q2 client-cash revenue was already $443.5M at a 337bp bank-sweep yield on $54.1B of balances, so a hike that the rates market is treating as a financials derate is the cash-sweep engine, not a cut. RESOLUTION: the 2026-09-16 FOMC statement and the 2026-10-29 Q3 print, where client-cash revenue and sweep yield either hold near $443.5M / 337bps or they do not.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Q3 FY2026 results due 2026-10-29 showing client-cash revenue below $400 million or bank-sweep net yield compressing more than 20 basis points from Q2's 337bps, or organic advisory net-new-assets turning negative versus Q2's 8.7% annualized rate.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $334.00 on above-average volume, breaking the rising 50-DMA test and the July $330-340 shelf.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If LPLA has not printed a daily close above $370 (reclaim of the 20-day area from the $380 high) by 2026-10-13, the 50-day hold is a pause in distribution rather than a Stage-2 reset — exit and rotate.
